required_sequence: build candidate manifest from exact release assets
bind manifest and assets to the exact protected tag revision
verify every asset and manifest independently before publication
fail_closed_rules: Unsigned-candidate status cannot satisfy a release-signing gate.
Missing, duplicate, absolute or traversal-containing artifact paths are invalid.
A checksum match without a trusted attestation is insufficient for signed release evidence.
No signing key, token or credential may be stored in the repository.
non_claims: This repository contract does not create a signature or publish a release.
Protected tag execution and accountable release authority remain pending.
